newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony Corp to own 50 pct of Sony Pictures.
newsitem.headline: Sony Corp to own 50 pct of Sony Pictures.

text.p: Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc said on Thursday it would transfer a 50 percent stake in its wholly owned subsidiary Sony Pictures Entertainment (Japan) Inc to its parent Sony Corp on January 10.
By making Sony Pictures an equally owned company of Sony and Sony Music, the group aims to achieve synergy between the software and hardware businesses, Sony Music said in a statement.
Sony Pictures distributes in Japan films released by Columbia Pictures and TriStar Pictures, both units of Sony Corp, and produces videocassette tapes of such films for sale in Japan.
Sony Music will transfer 4,642 shares of Sony Pictures to Sony Corp at prices based the value of the shares on Sony Music's balance sheet, Sony Music said.
It said the transfer would not have much impact on Sony Music group's profit projections for the year to the end of next March.
